gaps.sentence: 'I have to catch the last train,' she said. She said she ___ catch the last train.
gaps.explanation: Have to (obligation) backshifts to had to after a past reporting verb.

gaps.sentence: 'Hand in your phones,' the invigilator instructed. The invigilator instructed us ___ in our phones.
gaps.explanation: Formal commands: instruct + object + to-infinitive; the particle 'in' stays with the verb.

gaps.sentence: 'Do you know the way?' she asked me. She asked me ___ the way.
gaps.explanation: Do you know → if I knew: no do-support in the reported clause.

gaps.sentence: 'Why hasn't she replied?' he wondered. He wondered why she ___ replied.
gaps.explanation: hasn't replied → hadn't replied: statement order and past perfect.

gaps.sentence: 'You should apply for the grant,' he told me. He ___ me to apply for the grant.
gaps.explanation: Advice is reported as advise + object + to-infinitive.

gaps.sentence: 'Don't leave your belongings unattended,' the announcement repeated. The announcement ___ passengers not to leave their belongings unattended.
gaps.hint: warn sb not to do sth
gaps.explanation: The warning fits warn + object + not to + infinitive.

gaps.sentence: 'Do you speak Japanese?' the interviewer asked. The interviewer asked ___ Japanese.
gaps.explanation: Yes/no question → if I spoke; present simple backshifts to past simple.

gaps.sentence: They ___ us that the museum had closed early.
gaps.explanation: Tell somebody (that)... — 'told' needs the direct personal object 'us'; 'said' cannot take it.
